text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the days and operating times of the existing commercial loading zone on Jamestown Crescent be amended. The proposed changes will align with the new delivery days and times for the Toronto Community Housing Jamestown Hub, Community Support Services.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing commercial loading zone in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., Wednesday and Friday, on the west side of Jamestown Crescent (west intersection), between a point 58 metres north of John Garland Boulevard and a point 20 metres further north to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., Monday and Tuesday.
